concerns: Cloudflare: httpx gets 429 from the listing and the info page; fetch_html falls back to the browser, which clears the challenge here ('switched to alternate browser profile'). Same result with --force-fallback. Status stays done but a runner-IP block is possible.

Product slugs are copy-pasted and disagree with the titles (e.g. slug 1st-4th-july vs title 2nd-4th July); the product title is treated as the source of truth. The product pages themselves carry no venue or extra detail.

Venue, CPD (RCS 'up to a maximum of 23.5 CPD points'), start time and description come from the shared /tag-training/atacc/ page and are applied to the UK group only; the Ireland course has no venue/city/CPD (region Ireland only).

Parent URLs are the category page (UK) and category#atacc-ireland (Ireland) because there is no per-course page; both are stable as dates roll off. If the site later adds another suffix (e.g. 'ATACC Scotland') it becomes another parent automatically.
Fee is the product price, which is GBP 1,450 inc. VAT per the info page (1,208.34 + VAT). The category listing is not paginated (5 products).

Coverage checklist: multi-day ranges parsed from titles (12-14 Mar etc.); price is on the grid (no external 'here' link, no image or PDF fee table, no Registration sub-page); no abstracts/call for papers (a course).
